steps: Enter amount in the amount input box.
Select USD from source dropdown and EUR from target dropdown.
View formatted exchange rate and converted total.

modules.title: Set Up Document Head and Metadata
modules.learningObjective: Construct the HTML5 doctype, viewport meta tags, title, and link the external styles.css stylesheet.
modules.lesson:
# Setting Up the HTML5 Document Shell

Every modern web application begins with an accessible, mobile-ready HTML5 skeleton. We define `<meta charset="UTF-8">` to ensure proper character encoding, and `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">` so our layout scales responsively across mobile screens and desktops.

In this module, you will set up `index.html` with its `<head>` elements and link the `styles.css` file.
modules.task: Create the basic HTML5 structure in `index.html` with `<!DOCTYPE html>`, an `<html lang="en">` tag, `<head>` containing title 'Currency Converter' and a `<link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">`, and an empty `<body>` tag.

# Layout Architecture with CSS Custom Properties

Design consistency is powered by centralized CSS variables (custom properties). By defining colors like `--bg-color` and `--card-bg` in `:root`, you ensure all subcomponents inherit consistent styling.

In this module, we place a `<div class="converter-card">` inside the document body and style it with a dark, modern aesthetic.

modules.title: Wire Up Conversion Calculation and LocalStorage
modules.learningObjective: Implement JavaScript logic to calculate exchange rates, update DOM text, and persist history to LocalStorage.
modules.lesson:
# DOM Events and LocalStorage Persistence

In this final behavior module, we link the UI elements to live vanilla JavaScript logic. We listen to the `input` event on `#amount-input` and `change` on currency dropdowns, calculate the exchange product, and serialize the log entries to `localStorage`.

Linking `<script src="app.js"></script>` at the bottom of the body completes the application.
modules.task: Add `<script src="app.js"></script>` before the closing `</body>` tag in `index.html`. In `app.js`, declare exchange rates, add event listeners for amount input and dropdown change, calculate conversion, and persist to LocalStorage.
